source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban rhythms" OR rhythmanalysis OR "urban time" OR "urban temporalities"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban rhythms" OR rhythmanalysis OR "urban time" OR "urban temporalities",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban rhythms" OR "urban temporalities" OR "urban time" OR "rhythmanalysis")
